column8: Revision-240 packed coordinate type: constructor decodes plane from bits 28..29, x from bits 14..27 and y from bits 0..13; method6623 reverses that layout; prior 04-player-info evidence: classKY stores plane/x/y and its constructors plus method6623/method6660 use the standard plane<<28 | x<<14 | y packing

classKY(int) stores bits 14..27 here; method6686 prints it as the first world coordinate and method6623 packs it into bits 14..27; prior 04-player-info evidence: classKY packing, equality and WorldView-local conversion consistently treat this as the 14-bit world x coordinate

classKY(int) stores bits 0..13 here; method6686 prints it as the second world coordinate and method6623 packs it into bits 0..13; prior 04-player-info evidence: classKY packing, equality and WorldView-local conversion consistently treat this as the 14-bit world y coordinate

classKY(int) stores bits 28..29 here and uses -1 as the invalid sentinel; method6674 tests that sentinel; prior 04-player-info evidence: classKY packs this in bits 28-29 and uses -1 as the invalid coordinate sentinel
Returns plane << 28 | x << 14 | y, the inverse of the packed-coordinate constructor; prior 04-player-info evidence: Returns plane<<28 | x<<14 | y
Returns packedValue >> 28, matching the coordinate constructor's plane extraction; prior 04-player-info evidence: Returns packed>>28
Returns packedValue >> 14 & 16383; PROJANIM_SPECIFIC_V4 uses it for both source and target packed coordinates; prior 04-player-info evidence: Returns packed>>14 & 16383
Returns packedValue & 16383, matching the coordinate constructor's y extraction; prior 04-player-info evidence: Returns packed & 16383
Returns tile << 7; Projectile uses it when applying coordinate deltas in local-unit space
Returns local >> 7, the inverse scale of tileToLocalBase for local-unit coordinates
Returns 64 + (tile << 7), the center of a 128-unit tile; classNG.method7883 uses it for non-entity projectile targets
Returns plane != -1, preserving the packed-coordinate invalid sentinel; prior 04-player-info evidence: Returns whether plane is not -1
Returns -1 for an invalid coordinate, otherwise delegates to the same plane/x/y packed layout
Assigns plane/x/y from the packed coordinate using the same bit layout and preserves -1 as invalid
